semiconductor_relevance: High — SVCS specializes in semiconductor-grade equipment for R&D and pilot fabs, particularly in thermal processing and deposition technologies.
summary: SVCS s.r.o. is a Czech Republic-based company that designs and manufactures advanced semiconductor processing equipment, including tabletop furnaces for diffusion and thermal processing. With over 26 years of experience, they cater to universities and R&D laboratories globally, providing flexible and modular solutions tailored to specific customer needs.
capabilities: Tabletop furnace systems for semiconductor-grade thermal processing
Modular control systems for customizable operations
Gas and liquid source integration for various doping methods

regional_presence.Czech Republic: The company is headquartered and has its production plant located in the Czech Republic, known as the Czech Silicon Valley.
